description: This file defines structures, constants, and functions for handling RLC UM PDU headers in a 3GPP LTE/NR protocol stack, including header size calculations, header parsing, and serialization.

classes.name: rlc_um_pdu_header
classes.description: Structure representing the header of a RLC UM PDU, including segmentation info, sequence number size, sequence number, and segment offset.

methods.name: rlc_um_read_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Parses a PDU header from a byte buffer view, extracting segmentation info, sequence number, and segment offset based on SN size.

methods.name: rlc_um_nr_packed_length
methods.description: Calculates the length in bytes of a packed PDU header based on its fields.

methods.name: rlc_um_write_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Serializes a PDU header into a byte buffer.
